name: webgpu-g3b-lit-blend-text
title: WebGPU G3b: lit materials with aux textures and PBR, the lighting block, blend/additive/Transparent, mid-frame SetViewProjection, UpdateSceneLighting and text with effects on Dawn/lavapipe, goldens against the software renderer and Vulkan
issue: WebGPU design C:/Method Notes Obsidian/orchestrator/proposals/webgpu-backend-design.md (W1-W10 ACCEPTED 2026-10-20). G0 (#188), G1 (#190 WGSL lit/unlit/text + parity test + Tint/naga validation), G2 (#196 core, Dawn prebuilt, error counting) and G3a (#201: meshes with the in-frame update rule, textures with CPU mips, pipeline and bind-group caches, uniform ring, unlit draws, goldens vs software) are merged. Read the design sections on the lit shader/material system/lighting block/blend states/text, the G3b row, 'must change for WebGPU' items that apply (row_major transpose-on-upload, separate texture/sampler, uniformity), the merged G2/G3a code (renderer/src/webgpu/*) and the Vulkan backend's lit/blend/text code as the template (renderer/src/vulkan/*, BlockMaterial, GpuLighting, GpuShaderInterface, the text pipeline and glyph atlas path), the WGSL files from G1 and their parity test. THIS ITEM IS G3b ONLY: (1) lit materials: aux textures (normal, metallic/roughness, etc. as the Vulkan material block defines), the lighting block upload (BuildLightingBlock), UpdateSceneLighting, PBR parameters, bind groups for the lit layout within the device limits checked in G3a (raise the required limits check if needed and say so), (2) blend states in the pipeline cache key becoming REAL: opaque, alpha blend, additive, Transparent ordering semantics as the software/Vulkan renderers define, depth write rules for transparents, (3) mid-frame SetViewProjection (the uniform ring must keep earlier draws' matrices), (4) TEXT with effects: the glyph atlas texture, the text pipeline (the G1 text.wgsl with derivatives: validated), text effects/multipass as the Vulkan text path does (look at how text effects multipass was implemented), UI/WorldCanvas/Image/Particles draws that go through the same material path, (5) TESTS in the webgpu job: Mesh/Model/Lighting/NormalMapPbr/EditModeLighting/Particles/Image/WorldCanvas/Text* goldens mirroring the Vulkan golden scenes, compared with the SOFTWARE renderer in lit mode with the documented tolerances (derive the tolerances from the Vulkan lit comparison class and measure: never loosen silently) and with Vulkan's structural/golden values where the Vulkan renderer is not in the job; zero validation errors in every test; leak/lifetime tests unchanged; (6) DOCS: the WebGPU rendering docs section (what draws now: everything the software renderer draws except what you list as unsupported; wireframe ignored with one warning per W9, no compute), conventions, golden tolerances table, docs/testing.html. Option stays OFF/CI-only (W8); code compiles as C against webgpu.h only (G4 will compile it with emdawnwebgpu: no Dawn C++ headers). Nothing builds locally for the engine; CI (12 checks) is the test; expect fix rounds; re-read every edit twice (CMake/YAML/C++ syntax); NEVER run taskkill or kill other processes; verify every docs sentence against the CODE; no attribution lines on commits; GitHub only via the wrapper; your FINAL message must be a real report (PR number, head sha, what you did, deviations), never a single word.
